_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: slope 0.8 / 1.2; CITL and O/E by quadrature over the normal linear predictor

agreement.claim: both engines report the same slope, calibration-in-the-large, O/E and AUC with their SEs
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0 after writing the SEs out. harness/diagnostic_examples.test.py recomputes the truths with scipy quadrature and root-finding, and shows the slope model's intercept differs from calibration-in-the-large by more than 0.05 on average.

recovery.claim: the estimates are close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The slope tolerance separates 2/3 from 1 (perfect calibration); the O/E tolerance separates 0.67 from 1. Measured by harness/diagnostic_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49 at the same order statistic.
